Rachel: SpectralMesh POC kickoff. Prospect asks: 500 qps sustained for 5m with p95 <=200ms. Must support customer KMS, no persisted PII logs. Need hosted vs dedicated pricing + a short runbook + questionnaire answers.

Julian: I'll own the load plan. Confirm model split redwood-3b 80% / redwood-7b 20%, region us-west2, avg in 64 tokens, avg out 128, peaks to 256?

Rachel: Correct.

Meera: Heads-up: sustained p95<=200ms at 500 qps is usually Dedicated + pre-warm. Hosted can hit bursts but tails degrade ~20-30% without reserved pools. We should plan KV priming and per-second metrics.

Talya: I'll handle the security questionnaire: KMS customer keys supported, key rotation via KMS, HSM partner option for dedicated/private, logging retention 7d default; can disable request logs for PII paths.

Julian: Proposed run plan (short): ramp 0->500 in 300s, steady 5m, cooldown 60s. Warmup: 10k priming requests. Metrics: p50/p90/p95/p99, tail heatmap, GPU util, KV hit rate, errors. Fallback: route 7b->3b when unavailable. Example load command: `wrk -t24 -c900 -d00:06:00 --latency -s scripts/llm_post.lua --rate 500 http://loadgen/llm`

Eli: Token calc: avg 192 tokens per req => steady window ~28.8M tokens; warmup ~2M. I'll produce hosted per-token and 3-month dedicated commit delta including KMS/HSM add.

deploy-bot: deploy: loadgen v2.4 -> staging at 2026-03-18T15:02Z :rocket:

Meera: Ops checklist: reserve Dedicated if chosen, prewarm KV (`python tools/prewarm_kv.py --model redwood-3b --requests 10000 --parallel 64`), enable fallback flag, gather 1s-granularity system metrics, store raw CSVs and traces.

Rachel: Actions: Julian run smoke tonight + full run tomorrow; deliver p95/p99 + CSVs by EOD Fri. Talya upload questionnaire. Meera confirm infra reservation. Eli send pricing scenarios. One-slide summary + raw CSVs.

Julian: ack.

Talya: ack, uploading in thread.

Eli: ack, drafting numbers now.
